svg.title: Simon Fraser University coat of arms - full colour
svg.desc: Original full-colour vector artwork extracted from Simon Fraser University Brand Guidelines, May 2015 (May Version 2), printed page 5 / PDF page 7. Source: https://web.archive.org/web/20151031032443id_/http://www.sfu.ca/content/sfu/clf/_jcr_content/main_content/download/file.res/SFU_brand_guidelines_May2015.pdf . Source drawing paths, white fills, outlines and outlined motto retained. Original PDF colours converted to sRGB for SVG display by MuPDF. Surrounding page text and white rectangular page background omitted; exterior background transparent. Copyright Simon Fraser University. No additional reuse rights are granted by extraction.
